mainEntity.name: Are chemical peels safe for all skin types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when the right peel is chosen. Our dermatologists select peels based on your specific skin type and concerns.

mainEntity.name: How long does the treatment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical chemical peel session lasts 30–45 minutes.
Superficial peels have little to no downtime, while medium and deep peels may need a few days of recovery.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients need 3–6 sessions for best results, depending on their skin concerns. Results last longer with good skincare and sun protection.
